name: ynab-mcp-server
description: Local MCP server for safe YNAB workflows, reconciliation, receipt splitting, bulk cleanup, scheduled transactions, and spending analysis.
long_description: A local-first Model Context Protocol server for YNAB. It supports bank-statement reconciliation, receipt splitting with proportional tax allocation, preview-protected bulk transaction cleanup, scheduled transaction management, and deterministic spending analytics. Read-only, preview, and explicitly enabled write modes let users choose their safety boundary without giving up the full workflow surface.

YNAB_ACCESS_TOKEN.title: YNAB Personal Access Token
YNAB_ACCESS_TOKEN.description: Your YNAB Personal Access Token. Generate one at: https://app.youneedabudget.com/settings/developer

YNAB_EXPORT_PATH.title: Export Directory Path
YNAB_EXPORT_PATH.description: Directory where exported transaction files will be saved. Leave empty for platform default: Windows/Mac use Downloads, Linux/Unix use Documents. Examples: ~/Desktop, C:\Users\YourName\Documents, /home/user/exports

YNAB_MCP_WRITE_MODE.title: YNAB Write Mode
YNAB_MCP_WRITE_MODE.description: read-only hides YNAB mutations; preview requires a short-lived confirmation token; enabled allows direct writes.

YNAB_MCP_TOOL_PROFILE.title: Tool Profile
YNAB_MCP_TOOL_PROFILE.description: core exposes common workflows, read-only exposes all read tools, and full exposes every available tool.
